name: Exit Intent Visitors Feedback – hear from visitors before they leave
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Find out why visitors leave your site – a customizable feedback popup appears the moment they intend to exit, so you learn what to fix before they’re gone.

Why Exit Intent Visitors Feedback?

Most visitors leave a website without ever telling you why. Exit Intent Visitors Feedback triggers a popup form when a user intends to exit your site, letting you collect valuable feedback at exactly the right moment – without disrupting the browsing experience.

Perhaps your website is difficult to navigate, or the content isn’t meeting expectations. Whatever the reason, this plugin gives visitors a non-intrusive way to tell you, and gives you the insight to improve.

The popup form is fully customizable: tailor the questions to your needs – design, content, or services – edit the answers, and match the popup’s appearance to your branding. From the WordPress dashboard you choose which pages the form appears on, how often it appears, and what questions are asked, then review the responses in detailed analytics.

Free Features

  • Exit Intent Trigger: The feedback popup appears when a visitor intends to leave.
  • Fully Customizable: Tailor the form’s questions and appearance to your site.
  • Editable Questions & Answers: Ask exactly what you want to know.
  • Page Targeting: Choose which pages display the feedback form and how often.
  • Detailed Analytics: Review collected feedback from your dashboard.
  • Lightweight: Minimal impact on your site’s performance.
  • Easy to Use: Install, configure from the dashboard, done.

How to Use – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the Visitor Feedback plugin.
  2. Open the plugin settings in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Edit the questions and answers, and customize the popup’s appearance.
  4. Choose which pages the form appears on and how often.
  5. Publish – feedback starts arriving as visitors leave.

Use Cases

  • Online Stores: Learn why shoppers abandon before checkout.
  • Blogs & Publishers: Find out whether content meets reader expectations.
  • Service Websites: Discover navigation or pricing concerns before visitors bounce.
  • Landing Pages: Collect objections you can fix to improve conversions.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Exit Intent Visitors Feedback”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open the plugin settings to configure your feedback form.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the plugin (.zip file).
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the .zip file, click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Alternatively, upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory and activate it from the Plugins menu.
sections.faq:
When does the feedback popup appear?

The popup is triggered by exit intent – it appears when a visitor is about to leave your site, so it never interrupts normal browsing.

Can I choose which pages show the feedback form?

Yes. From the plugin settings you can choose which pages the popup appears on and how often it is shown.

Can I edit the questions and answers?

Yes. The questions and answers are fully editable, so you can ask about your design, content, services, or anything else.

Does the plugin provide analytics?

Yes. The plugin includes detailed analytics so you can review the feedback visitors submit.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Will it slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and designed to have minimal impact on performance.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here.
